comment: Card id namespace registry. Implements docs/proposals/2026-10-03-card-id-namespace-guard-proposal.md section 3 (B5-2576). Each entry declares the MANDATORY token every id in that file must begin with. An empty idPrefix is a positive declaration of bare ids, not an absence of information. A new set picks a short, distinct, lowercase prefix and registers it here before its cards land; a prefix is never reused by a second set and never retired while cards carrying it remain in the pool.
